{{Top|leg}}
'''Project Aralia''' was an [[amusement park]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]]. A development team led by [[Hayzo Trebors]]<ref name="EGAS ">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> became interested in Aralia as a site for a planetary amusement park due to it having no known inhabitants.<ref name="GG4 ">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> Trebors secured the necessary permits from [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Targan]] of [[Rydar II]] in the same [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The park, to be dubbed "Project Aralia,"<ref name="CSWE I 39">{{CSWECite|I|39|Aralia}}</ref> began construction a few years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="GG4 " />

During construction, however, the park hit a snag: [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of intelligent [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] with an insatiable desire to gnaw on things. The construction manager reported the problem to Trebors, and he called in pest control specialists. Nevertheless, the exterminators turned up dead, apparently killed by the creatures they had been hired to kill.<ref name="EGAS " /> The orchestrated killing of the offworlders provided proof that the Ranats were intelligent, and Trebors thus needed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] permit to proceed with their extermination. Rather than try to prove them "useless and undesirable," as was Imperial law for [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species,<ref name="GG4 " /> Trebors opted to convince Governor Targan that the rodents were in fact only semi-sentient, and thus fair game if killing them were deemed self defense. The government complied, and the park was eventually finished.<ref name="EGAS " />

When another amusement park, called [[Galaxy Ways]], opened on Aralia, much of the planet's surface was given over to resort development. Nevertheless, Ranat-infestation problems plagued the developments.<ref name="GS ">{{WEGCite|story=Trouble at Galaxy Ways|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref>
